info.title: Smart Classroom Backend
info.description: Backend HTTP contract. Authenticated requests are limited to 100/minute/user. Roles and room membership are checked server-side. For MQTT and WebSocket first-frame authentication see backend-contracts.md and README.md. Hardware acceptance is pending.
